name: npm-automations
description: Runs an async npm ci when a package-lock.json project is entered via EnterWorktree (toggle: npm_ci_on_worktree) — moved out of coding-toolbox to centralize npm-lifecycle automation hooks.

npm_ci_on_worktree.title: Auto npm ci on worktree entry
npm_ci_on_worktree.description: When entering a git worktree (EnterWorktree) whose project has a package-lock.json, runs npm ci there in the background. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.
